title: Senior Platform Engineer, Event Streaming Platform (Kafka)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join Event Streaming team — the distributed team responsible for the Kafka infrastructure and event streaming systems that power business-critical workflows across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash.

You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of Platform Engineering and Reliability Engineering, building and running the streaming backbone that is used by thousands of services across 3 companies. This is deeply technical work: you'll own distributed systems at scale, contribute to long-term architecture decisions, and be working on the reliability of critical parts of infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, in-house Event Streaming abstraction (internally called Event Bus) and any future streaming platform technologies. These systems support critical workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Design, build and operate large-scale, event streaming infrastructure that supports critical production workloads.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, observability and automation of Kafka, Event Bus and related streaming components.
  • Debug complex distributed systems issues — latency issues, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, partition imbalances — and drive them to resolution.
  • Build infrastructure automation and self-healing capabilities that reduce operational toil and improve platform resilience.
  • Contribute to the team's 24/7 On-call rotation and incident response, and drive continuous improvement through pre-mortems, operational readiness checklists and post-mortem action items.
  • Partner closely with other teams within Storage organization and wider Core Infrastructure org, like SRE, Data Platform, and Caching teams across EU and US regions — including occasional collaboration in the EU evening hours. 
  • Shape the long-term architecture and evolution of our event streaming platform, contributing to RFCs and technical strategy.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.
  • Deep experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar — with the emphasis on building reliable, production-grade systems and libraries.
  • Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.
  • Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.
  • Strong communication and writing skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.
  • Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

  • Headless CMS & APIs: Direct experience configuring, managing, and querying headless CMS environments (Contentful strongly preferred), with a fluent understanding of HTTP, JSON, REST, and GraphQL.

title: Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
description:
Die KD Pharma Group ist ein mittelständisches, international agierendes Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Bexbach, Saarland und ist spezialisiert auf die Herstellung von kundenspezifischen Produkten, die den vielseitigen Bedürfnissen des globalen Markts entsprechen. Die KD Pharma Group ist eines der weltweit wenigen Unternehmen, das Omega-3 Konzentrate in einer Reinheit von bis zu 99,5 % anbietet. Dies gelingt durch die alleinige Fokussierung auf Erforschung von und Technologieentwicklung für Omega-3-Fettsäuren. Das ermöglicht der KD Pharma Group, maßgeschneiderte Lösungen bereitzustellen, mit denen sich jeder Kunde im globalen Wettbewerb von seinen Konkurrenten abgrenzen kann.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine/n Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d).

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Bearbeitung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung der betreuten nationalen und internationalen Gesellschaften

  • Selbstständige Buchung aller Geschäftsvorfälle in Haupt-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung (MS Navision/Business Central/DATEV)

  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB

  • Durchführung von Abstimmungen und Klärung von Konten und buchhalterischen Auffälligkeiten

  • Durchführung von Rückstellungs- und Abgrenzungsbuchungen

  • Bearbeitung der Anlagenbuchhaltung einschließlich Abschreibungsläufen

  • Durchführung von Intercompany-Abstimmungen

  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Reporting- und Auswertungsunterlagen

  • Unterstützung bei umsatzsteuerlichen Fragestellungen sowie bei der Erstellung umsatzsteuerlicher Meldungen

  • Unterstützung im Bereich der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, insbesondere bei der Pflege und Aktualisierung von Personalstammdaten

  • Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Strukturen innerhalb der Finanzbuchhaltung

  • Ansprechpartner für Wirtschaftsprüfer und Steuerberater

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK), alternativ vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Finanzbuchhaltung

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der laufenden Buchhaltung sowie idealerweise Erfahrung im Bereich Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen; Kenntnisse in MS Navision/Business Central und DATEV Rechnungswesen von Vorteil

  • Gute Kenntnisse im Handelsrecht (HGB) sowie im deutschen Umsatzsteuerrecht

  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen im Bereich der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, insbesondere in der Pflege von Personalstammdaten

  • Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

  • Organisationsgeschick und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

Benefits

  • Abwechslungsreiche, vielseitige und herausfordernde Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Einarbeitung „on the job“ in einem engagierten und kompetenten Team
  • Individuelle Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem international tätigen Unternehmen
  • Faire Vergütung mit Zusatzleistungen wie Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Kostenfreies Wasser und Kaffee
  • Unternehmensprodukte zu Mitarbeiterrabatten
  • Betriebsevents

title: Senior Manager Treasury (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest einen Treasury Bereich nicht nur operativ betreuen, sondern Strukturen und Prozesse von Grund auf mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln? Dann könnte diese neu geschaffene Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. Unser Kunde ist ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit rund 370 Mitarbeitenden und gestaltet seit vielen Jahren die Energiewende aktiv mit. Das Leistungsspektrum reicht von Photovoltaik über Batteriespeicher bis hin zu Ladeinfrastruktur für Privatkunden, Gewerbe und Industrie. Für den weiteren Ausbau der Finance Organisation wird nun erstmals ein zentraler Senior Manager Trasury gesucht.

Aufgaben

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle übernimmst du die zentrale Verantwortung für das operative Treasury und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Finance Management zukunftsfähige Strukturen und Prozesse.

  • Liquiditätssteuerung: Verantwortung für die tägliche Cash Disposition sowie Erstellung und laufende Aktualisierung der operativen 13 Wochen und strategischen 13 Monate Liquiditätsplanung.
  • Cash Management: Steuerung des internen und externen Zahlungsverkehrs sowie Weiterentwicklung bestehender Cash Pooling Strukturen.
  • Finanzierungen: Administration von Intercompany Finanzierungen sowie Strukturierung und Verwaltung externer Finanzierungen und Kreditlinien.
  • Bankenmanagement: Zentrale Ansprechperson für Kernbanken und Finanzierungspartner sowie Verhandlung geeigneter Finanzierungslösungen.
  • Avalmanagement: Steuerung und Verwaltung bestehender Aval und Bürgschaftslinien.
  • Treasury Prozesse: Analyse und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen, Systemen und Kostenstrukturen sowie Identifikation sinnvoller Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Schnittstellen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Finance Management, Accounting sowie Wirtschaftsprüfern und Steuerberatern.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung, ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Treasury oder Controlling oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Treasury, Finance oder Bankenumfeld.
  • Fundierte praktische Kenntnisse in Liquiditätssteuerung, Cash Management und Zahlungsverkehr.
  • Erfahrung mit Cash Pooling, Intercompany Finanzierungen, Kreditlinien und der Zusammenarbeit mit Banken.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel sowie Erfahrung mit ERP Systemen.
  • Souveränes Auftreten und sichere Kommunikation mit internen Stakeholdern, Banken und externen Partnern.

Nice to haves: Hier ist jedes zusätzliche Wissen ein Pluspunkt

  • Erfahrung in der Optimierung oder dem Aufbau von Treasury Prozessen und Strukturen
  • Kenntnisse in SAP Business One
  • Erfahrung mit Digitalisierung und Automatisierung im Treasury oder Finance Bereich
  • Interesse am sinnvollen Einsatz von KI innerhalb von Finance und Treasury

Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Freue dich auf ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Eine neu geschaffene Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung und der Möglichkeit, den Treasury Bereich aktiv aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem etablierten Familienunternehmen innerhalb einer zukunftsorientierten Branche.
  • Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr sorgen für einen verlässlichen Ausgleich.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Vielfältige fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten über die unternehmenseigene Akademie.
  • Gesundheit: Betriebliche Zusatzkrankeversicherung mit 70% Zahnersatz und 300€, Firmenfitness sowie verschiedene Angebote rund um Gesundheit und Vorsorge.
  • Mobilität: Mit dem JobRad Leasing kannst du dir dein Wunschrad zu attraktiven Konditionen sichern.
  • Persönliche Unterstützung: Eine externe Mitarbeiterberatung steht dir bei beruflichen und persönlichen Anliegen zur Verfügung.
  • Unternehmenskultur: Dich erwarten eine gelebte Du Kultur, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Umfeld, in dem eigene Ideen ausdrücklich erwünscht sind.

Du möchtest deine Treasury Erfahrung in einer neu geschaffenen Schlüsselposition einbringen und dabei viel Gestaltungsspielraum übernehmen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Controller (m/w/d)
description:
Unser Kunde aus der Branche der erneuerbaren Energien verfolgt das Ziel, nachhaltige Energieversorgung für Privatkunden, Unternehmen und Industrie zugänglich zu machen. Als Controller unterstützt du die wirtschaftliche Steuerung des Unternehmens. So verbindest du analytische Arbeit mit einem klaren Zukunftsbezug.

  • Reporting: Erstellung von Monats, Quartals und Jahresreportings für die Unternehmensgruppe.

  • BI Tools: Unterstützung beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung moderner BI Lösungen.
  • Reporting Systeme: Pflege von Reporting Systemen und Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität.
  • Business Partnering: Übernahme der Rolle als betriebswirtschaftlicher Sparringspartner für Fachabteilungen.

Qualifikation

  • Studium: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen und Controlling oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Berufserfahrung: Als Controller bringst du mindestens vier bis sechs Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling mit.
  • MS Excel: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel.
  • SAP Business One: Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit SAP Business One.
  • BI Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen BI Tools.

Benefits

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung: Langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.
  • Homeoffice Möglichkeit: Flexible Kombination aus Büro und mobilem Arbeiten.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Mehr Freiraum für Beruf und Privatleben.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub: Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Projekte.
  • Weiterbildung: Umfangreiche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten über die interne Akademie.

  • Jobrad: Nachhaltige Mobilität mit attraktiven Konditionen.
  • Firmenfitness: Unterstützung deiner gesundheitlichen Ziele.

title: Senior BI Developer (m/f/d) - Microsoft Fabric & Power BI
description:
Remote, CET/CEST or SAST-aligned time zones | Full-time | Start: as soon as possible

Build business-critical data products that turn trusted data into better decisions and action.

Using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Azure, you will create lakehouses, semantic models, reports and AI-driven data products. These can include automated workflows, bots, copilots and agents.

You use AI-native delivery methods as a professional standard. This includes current LLMs, automation and agent platforms where they improve the product or solve a real client problem.

MultiBase delivers business-critical BI and analytics solutions for mid-sized companies across the DACH region. Since 1991, we have completed 1,500+ projects for 400+ clients. Our work covers manufacturing, automotive, financial services, pharma and other data-intensive sectors.

We are hiring a Senior BI Developer to expand capacity across established long-term client work. You bring technical depth, ownership and the ability to discuss your own technical topics directly with clients.

Tasks

The role

You build, test, document and maintain data products. This includes data models, lakehouses, data warehouses, pipelines, notebooks and Power BI reports.

You report to a Tech Lead and work closely with project leads, other developers and client teams. You clarify the technical detail and estimate the effort before delivery starts. You show what you built and explain your decisions clearly.

Project leadership, commercial ownership and people management remain with the project lead. Your mandate is senior technical delivery, direct technical client communication and reliable execution.

You work within MultiBase's DECIDE delivery framework: Discover, Engage, Clarify, Illustrate, Develop and Embed. You receive structured onboarding into the client context, delivery standards and framework.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain BI and data products in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and Azure.
  • Deliver lakehouse, warehouse, pipeline, notebook, SQL object and reporting components.
  • Develop Power BI semantic models, reports and DAX calculations.
  • Translate defined business needs into clear technical stories and delivery steps.
  • Discuss your own technical topics directly with client IT and business stakeholders.
  • Work in structured agile delivery. Estimate work, manage your stories and deliver against sprint commitments.
  • Use AI tools systematically to improve your development, analysis, documentation and quality assurance workflows.
  • Design and develop AI-driven data products that connect trusted client data, LLMs and defined business workflows.
  • Identify and prototype practical use cases for automations, bots, copilots and agents within client data environments.
  • Turn proven AI prototypes into secure, documented and maintainable data products.
  • Test, document and deploy production-ready data products.
  • Use version control and collaborative delivery practices, ideally Git and Azure DevOps.
  • Raise delivery risks, data issues and unclear requirements early with the Tech Lead and project lead.
  • Identify concrete improvement opportunities in client data landscapes.Contribute reusable documentation and practical knowledge to MultiBase's internal knowledge base.

Requirements

Who you are

You are technical first. You also communicate comfortably with a client's controller, data architect or business lead.

You ask clear questions before you build. You explain trade-offs directly. You take responsibility for your work and communicate early when an issue needs attention.

You look beyond dashboards and reports. You recognize when a trusted data product, automated workflow or AI-driven bot, copilot or agent is the right way to create insight or improve a client process.

You enjoy a role with real ownership, direct client exposure and a high standard of delivery.

Essential experience

  • At least four years of BI or data-platform development experience, including direct work with client or business stakeholders.
  • Strong Azure data-platform experience, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory or Synapse.
  • Practical experience with lakehouse and data warehouse concepts, data pipelines and notebooks.
  • Professional Power BI capability, including semantic modeling, DAX and report development.
  • Strong SQL and dimensional data-modeling skills, including star-schema design and ETL/ELT patterns.
  • Experience delivering in agile teams using structured stories, estimates and sprint commitments.
  • Experience using Git and a collaborative development workflow. Azure DevOps is an advantage.
  • Experience testing, deploying and maintaining production data products.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.
  • Daily, thoughtful use of AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or equivalent. You verify outputs and remain accountable for quality.

Strong advantages

  • Hands-on experience designing, building or deploying AI-driven data products, bots, copilots or agents for real business use cases.
  • Experience with current LLMs and small language models, including practical decisions about model choice, cost, latency, privacy and quality.
  • Experience with LLM APIs, agent orchestration or automation platforms such as OpenClaw, Claude Code or Cowork, Hermes, n8n, Make or comparable tools.
  • Experience turning LLM, SLM or agent prototypes into secure and maintainable data products.
  • Databricks experience, especially for data engineering, lakehouse and notebook-based work.
  • Python or PySpark for data engineering, automation or notebook workflows.
  • German at B2 level or above for DACH client communication.
  • Experience delivering in a client-facing project environment.
  • A habit of actively sharing knowledge with teammates and contributing to the growth of company expertise.
  • An active interest in market and technology developments, which you bring back to the team rather than keep to yourself.

Benefits

The working environment

  • Remote-first across CET/CEST or SAST-aligned time zones.
  • Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00 CET/CEST.
  • Occasional client visits are part of the role, normally several times per year and no more than once a quarter.
  • Developers based outside Germany attend working sessions at the MultiBase headquarters in Gilching at least twice a year.

title: New Patient Nurse
description:
If you became a nurse because you wanted to genuinely make a difference to patients lives, but you are ready to do it in a completely different way, this could be the role for you.

We are looking for experienced nurses who are ready to step away from traditional ways of working and into an innovative, fully remote clinical environment. You will speak to patients who have often spent years trying different treatments and managing conditions that have had a huge impact on their everyday lives.

This is a different way of nursing. You will use your clinical experience, judgement and ability to really listen to patients to help decide the next step in their treatment journey.

It is fast paced, constantly evolving and you will need to be comfortable with change. Most importantly, you will be working somewhere where the patient genuinely is at the centre of what we do and where the decisions you make can have a real impact on someone's quality of life.

What is the Role?

This is a remote clinical role sitting at the heart of the patient journey at Montu. As a New Patient Nurse, you will be the first clinical point of contact for patients seeking cannabis-based medical treatment. You will conduct structured video consultations to gather medical histories, assess suitability, and determine whether a patient is ready to progress to one of our consultants.

This role does not include prescribing or treatment delivery. What it does include is complex clinical decision-making, a fast-moving caseload, and patients who have often tried everything else before reaching us. You will need to be confident working autonomously, comfortable in a fully remote environment, and genuinely invested in getting the right outcome for every patient.

If you are looking for a quiet life, this is not the role for you. If you want to do meaningful clinical work from home and be part of a growing team that is changing how patients access medicine, it is.

This is a full-time role, working 40 hours per week. You will be required to work 1 Saturday per month, for which a day in lieu will be provided. This role is fully remote.

What Will You Be Doing?

  • Conducting video-based pre-assessment consultations with prospective patients

  • Taking detailed medical histories including current medications, relevant family history, and prior treatment

description:
An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

 

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

 

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

     

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

     

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles based on experience and hours worked.

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private Healthcare

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

  • Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients)

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

 

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). What we’re looking for

  • You've run high-volume creative testing on performance marketing and can talk specifically about what you learned, not just what you shipped.

  • You have opinions about what makes an ad work and can articulate them well.

  • You write well for ads. Briefs, hooks, scripts etc.

  • You're comfortable being wrong in public. A lot of tests lose, and the loop only works if we’re all comfortable with that.

What you’ll do

You will take accountability for the integrity of the full commercial funnel from top-of-funnel marketing through to churn and renewals. Right now, each function applies its own definitions and rules. You'll set one consistent set of rules and make them stick across the entire business. You'll also be responsible for forecasting, headcount planning and supporting the design of commission structures.


This is a hands-on, senior operator role. You'll own the tech stack (HubSpot sits at the centre), and you'll build the workflows, automations and permissions that keep data clean at source. You're not tidying records by hand; you're designing systems. You'll also be working with AI daily – it's not optional here. There are no commissions or bonuses in this role and that is deliberate. The role has to stay objective about what the figures say.   • You work best with autonomy. You're a self-starter who gets the work done yourself, not someone who needs to manage others to feel productive.

YOU PROBABLY SHOULDN'T APPLY IF:

  • You've spent your career managing the sales pipeline in isolation, without visibility into marketing and customer success.

  • You'd struggle with HubSpot or you'd need somebody else to handle the tech stack. This is not negotiable, unfortunately.

  • AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. You see it as something that reduces your value, not something that multiplies what you can deliver.

  • You need a large team beneath you from day one. This role starts solo and hands-on, though you'll build a team over time.

Experience

You've spent time in a revenue operations, commercial operations or similar role, with demonstrable ownership of the full commercial funnel. You've done the work yourself – like configuring HubSpot, building forecasts, and leading alignment conversations across functions. Multi-product SaaS experience is non-negotiable; B2B exposure is strongly preferred.

 

Tooling

HubSpot sits at the centre, and you're an expert here. Experience with other platforms, such as Salesforce or Pipedrive, is a plus (some skills transfer). You're comfortable across other tech stacks and you use AI regularly as part of your workflow. Other tools in the stack will change and you're flexible on that front.


Communication

You can present to senior audiences without losing clarity. You push back on senior leaders when the numbers don't match the narrative, and you do it diplomatically enough that they listen rather than push back harder. You explain complex commercial logic in plain language.


Research

You think operationally. You diagnose what's broken in a process, you ask tough questions about data quality, and you can identify which problems to tackle first based on commercial impact. You're curious about how the business actually works, not just the metrics.

title: Product Owner – Autonomous Lending
description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Allica Bank aims to provide Expert Banking for Business Britain by providing excellent customer experience and pioneering technology solutions to facilitate this.

The Autonomous Lending tribe runs across multiple business lines including Credit Operations and Underwriting, with a mission to build AI-first lending origination journeys, automating origination capabilities, data flows, and underwriting and operational workflow management.

The tribe is a critical driver for Allica to continue to realise its vision of providing a market leading relationship-based banking experience, at a speed and cost to serve the rest of the market cannot match.

Role Description
The Product Owner will lead the work to define, deliver and manage AI-enabled products across our lending journeys, bringing together product design and thinking with a strong working knowledge of what today’s AI can and cannot do.

You will be accountable for the roadmap of your team and for the full product lifecycle: discovery and design, day-to-day delivery, launch and adoption by colleagues and customers, and how risks are addressed once a product is live. You will aim to build robust, automated and well-governed systems and processes that enable us to move quickly and innovate our lending and financing products in the SME banking market.

Whilst a lot of the market aims to avoid the complex nature of SME businesses, we are going for it head on, designing simple and efficient solutions to the most complex problems in the market to provide excellent and efficient customer experience. We aim for our external view of the lending product, as well as our internal systems to be the best in market which will allow us to scale quickly to serve more UK SMEs, while doing so in a cost-effective manner.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Responsible for innovation and building end-to-end solutions for AI-enabled lending product, origination, underwriting and operational flows

  • Lead a small cross-functional team (e.g. a full stack engineer and AI specialist) to deliver your roadmap

  • Continuously review business needs, refine priorities and iterate towards measurable outcomes – judged on fewer requests for further information, more applications decided with AI, less colleague time per application across underwriting and credit operations, and risk outcomes no worse than the equivalent manual journey

  • Prototype and experiment quickly – vibe-code working prototypes yourself, close enough to the real thing that an engineer can harden it into production code

  • Determine the accuracy of AI solutions by analysing the data yourself and building the verified “ground truth” datasets that results are tested against, working with underwriters and credit operations colleagues to agree what a correct answer looks like

  • Take responsibility for launch and adoption – briefing stakeholders, training the teams who will use the product, and closing the loop on the feedback they give back

  • Produce the written work that keeps delivery moving and safe – clear descriptions of what we are building and why, a record of the important design decisions and trade-offs made, and the assessments needed to get a product approved and live, covering risk, security, cost, data and legal considerations, and taking the change through the bank’s governance and approval process

  • Line manage, coach and develop your team, setting a high bar for delivery and for the responsible use of AI

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Knowledge of commercial lending origination and underwriting processes, principles and systems

  • Experience in a fast-moving or high-growth business

  • Proven track record of delivering agentic and data-driven products into live use

  • Strong process design, implementation and automation skills

  • Hands-on familiarity with Python, SQL and data analytics tools, alongside LLM tooling, prompt engineering and AI orchestration – you do not need to be an engineer or an analyst, but you should be able to build something that works, query the data yourself, and understand and sense-check what AI is producing

  • Understanding of privacy and safety considerations when applying LLMs in production, and of how to prove and monitor accuracy once a solution is live – ideally in a regulated environment

  • Strong analytical skills and business acumen, comfortable digging into data yourself to size a problem, measure performance and assemble the reference datasets accuracy is judged against

  • Metric and outcome driven approach – setting the measures up front, tracking them once a product is live, and stopping work that is not moving them

  • Experience working with or leading product and engineering teams, and comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the problem is as novel as the solution

title: S&O Manager - Rider Fraud
description:
About the role

This role will lead our approach to understanding and reducing courier/rider fraud and abuse across Wolt and Deliveroo. Combining data-led investigation with strong operational judgement, you will identify emerging risk patterns, understand the features of our operating models that may contribute to those risks, and assess their potential impact.

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

  • Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

  • Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

  • Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys to identify where fraud or abuse risk may arise, using data, operational knowledge and structured, hypothesis-led analysis.

  • Develop analytical approaches and key metrics to identify patterns, quantify impact, assess detection signals and measure the effectiveness of policy interventions over time.

  • Define new policies, or revise existing ones, in response to identified risks that may negatively affect customers, couriers/riders, the platform or the wider business.

  • Conduct impact and risk assessments, framing clear options and recommendations that consider effectiveness, operational feasibility, cost, legal and regulatory requirements, and potential unintended consequences.

  • Partner closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science, Trust and Operations teams to shape business requirements, implement agreed responses and resolve complex trade-offs.

  • Establish effective ways of working across Wolt and Deliveroo so that emerging trends, priority risks and lessons from policy performance are identified early and shared with relevant stakeholders.

  • Lead cross-functional delivery from problem identification through to implementation, reporting and post-launch monitoring, adapting the approach as new evidence emerges.


What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years’ experience in fraud, risk, compliance, policy, operations, consulting or a related field.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to combine data, operational context and judgement to identify root causes and prioritise action.

  • Experience translating complex or ambiguous risk issues into practical policies, recommendations and implementation plans.

  • Experience navigating complex legal and regulatory landscapes and working constructively with Legal and Public Policy stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders and challenge constructively when needed.

title: Senior Customer Support Engineer
description:
About Fyxer

Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the hardest technical tickets in the business end to end, including the customer conversation, from first report through to resolution

  • Dogfood Fyxer’s own products, give feedback, and influence our roadmap

  • Establish blast radius before escalating, because one customer reporting something is a ticket and forty-seven accounts in the same broken state is an incident

  • Call bug, incident or user error correctly and quickly, and declare it when it's an incident

  • Write escalations Engineering can act on without a single follow-up question, and stay on them until they land

  • Spot patterns across Linear and the queue, raising a tracker before the fifth report of something becomes the tenth

  • Reduce the need for your own role through runbooks, saved queries, Parahelp knowledge, and hands-on upskilling of our senior agents

Here's the honest version of why this role exists. In one recent three-month window we escalated 47 tickets to Engineering and two of them were resolved. Engineering is capacity-constrained, and a third of what we sent them was correctly deprioritised. So this isn't a role that escalates better, it's one that resolves. You'll be backed by strong Customer Success and Product Engineering teams, and given read-only access to our codebase through Cursor, to our data through our internal tooling, and to our production logs to do it.

What Success Looks Like

  • You resolve a growing share of technical escalations without Engineering ever being involved

  • Your escalations are complete, so Engineer can act on them quickly

  • You use AI and you catch it when it's wrong, before it reaches a customer

  • You hold a customer's confidence while you investigate, rather than handing them back to someone else

  • Our senior agents are visibly more capable six months in than they are today, because of you

  • You're the person the team wants on the ticket because they trust your judgement.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in a technical support role within a SaaS or cloud-based company

  • API fluency: you can read an API reference, reason about authentication, and say what a 401 rather than a 500 tells you about where the fault sits

  • SQL you write yourself: given an unfamiliar schema you work out how the tables relate and write the join unaided

  • Comfortable in logs, following a request across services and working backwards from an error

  • Strong written communication, particularly to a customer who is unhappy

  • Experience with customer support tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, Jira, Linear, others

  • Startup-ready: adaptable, fast-moving, and hands-on

We're not asking for production engineering experience or a computer science degree. We care what you can do, not how you got there.

Location and other bits

  • Based in our Chancery Lane office in London, Monday to Thursday, with Fridays from home

  • Standard office hours

  • Benefits include: on-site gym, private medical, pension and lunch provided everyday

The Hiring Process

  1. Submit your CV (no need for a cover letter)

  2. We'll review it

  3. An initial call with someone from the hiring team to review your experience and motivation for joining (30 mins)

  4. A call with our Head of Customer Support on your experience and how you think technically (30 minutes)

  5. A live technical exercise (60 minutes)

  6. Meet more of the team (30 minutes)

For the exercise we'll give you access to a small example application, a database, an API and its logs, a couple of days ahead, along with three customer tickets. You don't need to solve anything in advance, and you're welcome to use whatever AI tooling you normally would, because that's how the job actually works. We'll be paying attention to how you check its answers.

Our Culture

Our culture is intentional. It stems from the fact we're in the race of our lives to reshape one of the largest AI opportunities that exist; email. There is only first or last.

We're going to win by:

  • An obsession around the fact that every second counts, we have to move fast with intensity and drive hard every day.

  • Never let it slide, be relentless in challenging yourself and others to strive for the best outcome.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we'll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

  • Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.

  • A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.

  • Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.

  • Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.

Probably not for you if

You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.

The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.

The hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

  1. Call with Imani, our Head of People and Talent. You'll get a proper picture of the role and the company, and we'll get into how you work and how you build.

  2. System design session with our engineering team. No leetcode and no take-home. We want to see how you approach a problem and structure a solution.

  3. Paid trial day. A real Odin problem with everything you need handed to you. You see how we work, we see how you ship.

Working at Odin

Two setups work for this role: London hybrid (three days a week in the office) or remote from elsewhere in Europe with quarterly trips to London.

description:

Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. We're looking for someone who loves building automations, agents and workflows, and wants to point that instinct at People Ops. You'll own the data and systems behind our People Ops stack (HiBob, Ashby, Remote), and use that ownership as the foundation for turning slow, manual, multi-tool processes into things that mostly run themselves. This is a role for someone who'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month planning the perfect system - someone who gets a genuine kick out of making the unglamorous stuff disappear. You’ll bring expertise, energy, and commercial thinking to help us elevate our People processes.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automations, workflows, and AI agents across our People Ops tooling (HiBob, Ashby, Remote) - from a simple triggered workflow to a more sophisticated internal agent - turning multi-step manual processes into things that run themselves.

  • Own the data layer everything else depends on: keep HiBob/Ashby/Remote data clean, resolve integration and schema issues between systems, and treat data integrity as the foundation of what you build, not an afterthought.

  • Run new joiner onboarding end to end, but treat every manual step you touch twice as a candidate for automation, with the goal is to keep making the process faster and lighter-touch, not just execute it reliably.

  • Administer employee lifecycle changes (promotions, transfers, terminations) across systems, and build the guardrails - validation rules, alerts, review steps etc, that catch data errors before they become a downstream mess in payroll or compliance.

  • Process documentation: create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and playbooks for onboarding, offboarding, and systems admin current as processes evolve, so nothing lives only in your head.

  • Partner with relevant stakeholders on anything touching UK employment or compliance judgement calls while you build fluency here. You own the system and the escalation path, and that ownership shifts to you over time.

Your background:

  • You can genuinely build: hands-on with automation/workflow tools (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, Retool or similar), and you've actually built or configured AI agents.

  • You've worked with structured data and APIs enough to reason about schemas, integrations, and what breaks when two systems disagree with each other.

  • You're comfortable being the systems administrator of SaaS platforms: owning permissions, workflows, and integrations, ideally across an HRIS/ATS/EOR stack (HiBob, Ashby, Remote) or a comparable set of business systems.

  • You've worked in a high-growth environment, ideally remote and across multiple geographies, and you're comfortable working async across EMEA time zones.

  • Any exposure to People Ops, HR systems, or UK employment practices is a genuine bonus, not a

  • requirement - we're hiring for the builder instinct first, and will coach the domain knowledge.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You're an Owner. You don't wait to be told the onboarding flow needs fixing, you notice the friction and you just fix it.

  • You're Fast. You'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month designing the perfect one.

  • You like Simple. Your default build is the one with the fewest moving parts, not the most impressive one.

  • You find Surprising in the unglamorous stuff. You get a kick out of turning "someone does this by hand every month" into something nobody thinks about again.

  • You're Human, even with agents. You know the systems you're building sit behind someone's first week at a new job, or a colleague's benefits question — you design for that person, not just for the workflow diagram.

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Number and scope of manual People Ops processes automated, and time saved per cycle

  • HiBob / Ashby / Remote data accuracy rate

  • Reduction in error rate flowing into compliance-relevant fields

description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE

 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 

 

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. We give each of them a stellar production that combines creative copy, world-class voice artistry and an exclusive Brand-Sound-Track™ – strengthening their business identity in the most memorable, emotive way.

description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly-motivated and driven platform engineer, with experience in enabling a DevOps culture within tech teams. In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide a world-class developer experience to other engineers. You will have the autonomy to build solutions for the fascinating problems that we have to solve, allowing our customers (the software engineers) to build products quickly, securely, and to a high standard of quality.

What you'll do

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Designing and implementing high quality infrastructure as code templates/modules, and empowering software engineers to use them for their projects.

  • Implementing AWS multi-account core infrastructure, and ensuring security best practices are being used across the cloud estate.

  • Authoring CI/CD templates and optimisations to ensure that engineers can release as early and often as possible.

  • Designing and implementing a developer portal, to provide a service catalog to the engineering team, and also author many other useful DevOps plugins.

  • Contributing to observability best practices and providing key SLI/SLO metric reporting, so that the engineering team can balance velocity and reliability.

  • Develop inner/open source projects to help provide a world-class developer experience to the engineering team.

 

About You

This role will be a great fit if you have:

  • Good working knowledge of AWS services including ECS, EC2, Lambda, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS

  • Good understanding of monitoring and logging solutions. We use OpenTelemetry, AWS Cloudwatch and SigNoz so experience with them is a bonus.

  • Basic SRE knowledge, and experience in alerting and incident management platforms (eg. incident.io, Pagerduty)

  • Proven ability to provide and support strong and scalable CI/CD pipelines

  • Linux, Git, Docker and good scripting skills in e.g. Python, bash, Go. You should be proficient in at least one modern programming language.

  • Good experience in defining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.

  • Knowledgeable and comfortable with Agile development practices

  • Great appetite for learning and self-improvement

  • A real passion for developer experience, as well as an understanding and enthusiasm for Platform Engineering as a discipline

  • Previous experience in fintech is a bonus

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

title: Senior Construction Project Manager
description:
Elgin Values

Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees
 
Agility We Lead with Agility  Integrity We Act with IntegrityExcellence We Empower ExcellenceCareWe Value Care


Job Description

Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

What you will be do:

  • Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
  • Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
  • Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
  • Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
  • Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
  • Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
  • Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
  • Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
  • Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
  • Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.


Your profile

What you will need: 

  • Degree in project management, construction management, engineering, or similar.
  • Extensive experience in infrastructure, renewables, power, energy storage or comparable capital projects, with significant project and contract management responsibility.
  • Direct experience working on project-financed projects, including lender due diligence, , funding drawdowns, lender technical adviser processes and ongoing lender / investor reporting.
  • Strong understanding of the Client / Employer’s Representative role and experience representing an owner, SPV, sponsor or employer in the delivery of complex contracted projects.
  • Extensive experience administering FIDIC, EPC, ICP and construction management contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment mechanisms, completion tests, liquidated damages and contractual close-out.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead multidisciplinary internal teams and align finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations and external adviser inputs around delivery milestones within a standardised delivery framework.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to assess risk versus reward, protect the employer’s position and communicate implications clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing and presenting concise, decision-ready reports for senior management, investment committees, SPV boards, lenders, investors, shareholder forums and other governance forums, with the ability to translate complex programme, commercial, technical and financing issues into clear options and recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of utility-scale solar PV, BESS, grid connection and route-to-market interfaces, with sufficient technical understanding to challenge contractors and advisers effectively.
  • Highly organised and proficient in Microsoft Office and project controls tools, with strong written communication, meeting management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Valid driver’s license for Ireland and the UK.
